stem: What was the purpose of this amendment?

options.label: A
options.text: To encourage citizens to monitor the federal government

options.label: B
options.text: To prevent conflicts between state and local governments

options.label: C
options.text: To limit the authority of the federal government

options.label: D
options.text: To increase the participation of citizens in state government

visual_elements: The powers not delegated to the United States by the Constitution, nor prohibited by it to the States, are reserved to the States respectively, or to the people. —U.S. Constitution, Tenth Amendment
